entries.target: A long attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Strike your opponent with fiery wrath, dealing large damage and converting your Elemental Power to Fire Magic. If you possess Earth Magic, the fusion makes you Incandescent, increasing your Endurance by 100% and Healing Intake by 200% for 20 seconds. If you possess Energy Magic, the fusion grants you Critical Mass, increasing your Crit Chance by 25% and Crit Damage by 125% for 10 seconds.

entries.target: A short range skill that heals yourself.
entries.officialDescription: Call upon the power of the earth, healing yourself. If Elemental Power is present, you heal twice as much and convert it into Earth magic. If you possess Fire Magic, the fusion creates Molten Armor, reducing the damage you take by 60% for 20 seconds. If you possess Energy Magic, the fusion grants you an Earthen Blessing, healing you for a small amount over the next 20 seconds.
